newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks nudge up in cautious trade, eye U.S..
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks nudge up in cautious trade, eye U.S..

text.p: MADRID, June 5 (Reuter) 0830 GMT - Madrid stocks nudged up in quiet early trade on Thursday, with volumes thin ahead of key U.S. jobs data tomorrow, dealers said.
The tone was cautious rather than nervous, awaiting more clarification regarding monetary union which may emerge from the EU finance ministers meeting this weekend, they added.
* General index down 0.66 points, 0.12 percent, to 556.81
* Building firms OCP, up 1050 pesetas to 8060 and Gines Navarro, up 340 pesetas to 2,890, after merger news.
Banks in particular were in focus, with Argentaria up 160 pesetas to 7,700, Santander gaining 160 pesetas ot 13,000 and BBV up 100 pesetas to 10,730.

Although French and German political factors affecting the timing and composition of monetary union were still weighing on the market, in general nervousness seemed to have faded, especially as the French markets had recovered.
"People have started to forget about (political woes) a little bit, although there's still some caution in there if you look at the (lower than average) volumes," said one trader.
